body: Deploying Product Forge SaaS or Enterprise editions currently requires executing multiple manual steps (database migration, object store setup, environment configuration, service runner startup). A turnkey enterprise product requires an automated one-command infrastructure-as-code deployment pipeline. This item provides the official Helm chart and Terraform modules.
_note: Full authoring of context, epic, and ACs

brief.problem: Plane A (Product Forge platform itself) lacks an automated turnkey one-click cloud provisioning bundle (Helm chart + Terraform), requiring manual database and cluster configuration.
brief.what_adds: Plane A One-Click Cloud Provisioner: Helm chart and Terraform modules for automated Product Forge cluster deployment.

label: PF Backlog 690
risks: Cloud provider API rate limits during infrastructure provisioning mitigated via idempotent Terraform state.
title: Plane A One-Click Cloud Provisioner: Helm chart and Terraform modules for automated Product Forge cluster deployment

impact_review.recommendation: APPROVE: Author authoritative Plane A infrastructure assets.

impact_review.claim: API CHECK: System Health and Readiness
impact_review.recommendation: APPROVE: Post-deploy verification queries existing GET /api/v1/health; no new routes required.
APPROVE: 3 detailed criteria (each >= 40 chars) covering Helm stack, Terraform multi-cloud, and sub-10m e2e deployment.

impact_review.claim: LANGUAGE RULE: Infrastructure as Code & Tooling
impact_review.recommendation: APPROVE: Helm YAML + Terraform HCL + Python orchestration runner in core/plane_a_deployer.py compliant with language rule.

assumptions: Cloud target environments for Plane A provisioner: AWS (EKS + RDS PostgreSQL) and GCP (GKE + Cloud SQL).
Local/Dev target supported via Minikube / Kind + Docker compose with single-click script.
Helm chart packages productforge-core, edpsvc, postgres-pgvector, and object store configuration.
Provisioning runner operates hermetically with dry-run and health check verification.
divergences: None: Establishes the authoritative Plane A turnkey cloud deployment assets without duplicating Plane B app-runner logic.
existing_path: core/deploy_providers.py:1: Plane B project deployment providers (Docker, K8s, Helm).
deploy/ or deploy/plane-a/: (none exists for turnkey Plane A cloud provisioning).
go/edpsvc/: native enterprise data plane service.
open_questions: None: Requirements align with production cloud native standards.
prior_decisions: ADR-0001 / BI-PF-0388: Single-source, multi-target platform; Plane A runtime lives in native Go + containerized services.
docs/E2E-WORKFLOW.md: Plane A (Product Forge platform itself) vs Plane B (generated customer apps).

summary: Build an official Helm chart and Terraform reference module for Product Forge (Plane A) that provisions PostgreSQL, S3/blob storage, mounts secrets, runs migrations, and deploys the compiled platform container services.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/control_plane.py, core/forge_constitution.py, core/forge_store.py, core/product_analyzer.py

approach: Author production Helm chart with subcharts for PostgreSQL/pgvector and MinIO, complemented by Terraform modules for AWS EKS and GCP GKE.
rollback: Terraform destroy / Helm uninstall script executing clean teardown.
objective: Build automated Helm chart and Terraform infrastructure modules for one-click turnkey deployment of Plane A Product Forge platform on Kubernetes.

api_impact.reason: Infrastructure-as-code and deployment orchestration CLI tooling; leverages existing GET /api/v1/health endpoint

verification: End-to-end deployment test executing one_click_deploy.sh on test cluster and verifying healthy status endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Helm chart deploys complete Product Forge platform stack including PostgreSQL with pgvector, object store, and core API pods.
AC-2: Terraform module automates cloud VPC, managed Kubernetes cluster, and database provisioning across AWS and GCP providers.
AC-3: Single command deployment script provisions infrastructure, deploys Helm chart, and passes automated post-deploy health check in under 10 minutes.
